senses.zh_definition: 蚊子的幼虫；孑孓。此义见于杜顺语词典，尚未核实为标准马来语词义。
senses.en_definition: A mosquito larva; documented as a Dusun word, with its status in standard Malay unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam sumber bahasa Dusun yang dirujuk, goki bermaksud jentik-jentik, iaitu larva nyamuk. Takrif ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: 可核实的对应义项来自 [Dusun Dictionary](https://dusundictionary.com/?letter=G)。不能据此认定为马来语借词或官方词条。以下搭配和例句均为编写的马来语元语言示例，用于讨论这个杜顺语词，并非已验证的高频搭配。输入中的频率排名仅按原资料保留。

etymology.historical_story: The available evidence identifies goki in a Dusun dictionary as a word for a mosquito larva. It does not establish the word’s historical origin, earliest occurrence, or adoption into Malay. This distinction matters in multilingual lexicography: a word documented in another Malaysian language should retain that language attribution until evidence supports treating it as a Malay borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 goki 与“水中扭动的小孑孓”联系起来，同时记住语言标签：杜顺语；马来语对应词是 jentik-jentik。此为联想记忆，并非词源解释。
